The rules every bootleg16 screen is built from. Every value here comes from one file, design/system/tokens.json, which also writes the game's Godot theme, so this page and the game can't drift apart. Every detail on a screen has a job: it shows information, shows state, or is something you use.

Marks

Who we are

White carries every mark, amber only on the 16. Keep at least 32 clear around each one.

WordmarkTitle screen, store pages, loading screens.
MonogramApp and Steam icon, the loading spinner, the HUD corner.
BureauA sun on the water. They defend, every round.
StraysThe pillar, blown apart. They attack, every round.
LiveOnly on live things: spectating, replays, the kill cam.
Colour

Every colour means something

Colour is information. Amber is you, red needs you now, cyan and pink are the two sides. Nothing gets a colour for looks.

Grid and spacing

Twelve columns, one scale

Every screen sits on 12 columns of 122 with 24 gutters, 96 from the sides and 64 from the top and bottom. Every gap is a step of the scale, never a number in between.

96 64 COLUMN 122 · GUTTER 24
xs4Icon to its text.
s8Between rows in a list.
m16Inside rows and buttons.
l24Between cards. The grid gutter.
xl32Between groups.
xxl48Between blocks of a screen.
huge64Screen margin, top and bottom.
max96Screen margin, left and right.

Motion

Alive, never noisy

Everything eases out fast and settles. Glitch only on arrival, hover start, a change of state or an alert, and always settles clean.
